prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Central African Republic
Primary request: Dzanga Bai forest clearing in the Central African Republic part of Sangha Trinational.
Subject: A broad natural sandy and muddy mineral clearing encircled by dense tall tropical rainforest, with a shallow winding stream and puddles crossing the sand pan. Show a small plausible group of African forest elephants, two adults, one subadult and one calf, quietly drinking, walking and probing the wet ground with their trunks.
Scene/backdrop: The actual type of Dzanga Bai habitat: an open lowland forest clearing surrounded by an unbroken green wall of humid rainforest. Forest elephants have rounded ears and relatively slender downward tusks; keep their anatomy and proportions credible.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable local habitat and wildlife, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Slightly elevated wide view into the bai; elephants are a modest middle-ground group comfortably inside central 75% width and height, with plenty of clearing and forest around them.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, peaceful and welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No zoo-like mixed animal gathering, cages, savanna grassland, mountains, ocean, buildings or unrelated animals. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp.
inspection: Inspected: Dzanga Bai-type sandy and muddy mineral clearing with a shallow winding stream and puddles enclosed by dense lowland rainforest. A small group of four forest elephants of different ages drinks and walks with plausible anatomy and proportions; no mixed zoo-like animal gathering. Scene is in the Central African Republic component, distinct from a generic Sangha river view. No buildings, mountains, readable text, flags, UI or logos.
